summary: Current production management is disabled and unprovisioned. The proposed stage1 strictly limits management reads but intentionally preserves existing authenticated player-list reads; it does not meet full private-player isolation.

findings.issue: Any authenticated user can read the existing player collection, which is also the ranking source.
findings.recommendation: Separate sanitized ranking projections before restricting player reads to the owner and administrator.

findings.issue: Password auth, technical admin account, ACL and management Rules are absent. enabled=true alone cannot activate the room.
findings.recommendation: Approve and verify explicit staged provisioning; keep writes disabled until transaction-coupled Rules and consumer integration are tested.

findings.issue: Current owner write rules validate nickname and distribution streak but do not fully validate point and appearance fields.
findings.recommendation: Design compatible validators and test existing data before any tightening; do not rewrite or reset existing values.
